tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You are a student who recently attended a guest lecture on climate change organized by your university. You really liked the lecture and would like to interview the speaker, Dr. Green, for an article in the university newspaper. You need to request an interview with Dr. Green. Write an email to Dr. Green.
bullets: Explain what you liked about the lecture.
Request an interview with a specific date and time.
Describe the purpose of the interview.
tasks.subject: Request for Interview on Climate Change Lecture
